newsitem.title: USA: Jacobson to close stores, take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Jacobson to close stores, take Q4 charge.

text.p: Jacobson Stores Inc said it would close three underperforming Michigan stores and take a related $2.7 million charge in the fourth quarter.

The company said in a statement released Saturday that it would close its locations in Jackson, Kalamazoo and Lansing. The stores account for less than seven percent of the specialty retailer's annual sales.
The company said about 175 of the 344 full- and part-time employees at the stores would be offered jobs at other Jacobson's stores or at the corporate offices.
"This transition is expected to begin in late February," it said.
The company will record a non-recurring charge of about $2.7 million against net earnings in the fourth quarter related to severance and other costs associated with the closings.
Jacobson operates 28 stores in Michigan, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Ohio and Florida.
